rationale: AI RMF 1.0's MAP outcomes cover intended context, knowledge limits and data/TEVV considerations; MEASURE addresses uncertainty and comparisons to performance benchmarks; MANAGE includes supersession, disengagement or deactivation. These support the bounded description of lifecycle risk-management outcomes. The current NIST landing page says AI RMF 1.0 is being revised, which makes the claim version-specific rather than false.
evidence_locators: S-EVID-001-R1 through S-EVID-001-R3, NIST AI 100-1, MAP/MEASURE/MANAGE outcomes, PDF pp. 26-32
NIST AI RMF landing page, lines 125-143, https://www.nist.gov/itl/ai-risk-management-framework
limitations: NIST states that AI RMF 1.0 is under revision, so the paper must name the 1.0 edition and refresh the claim before release.
The RMF is voluntary and horizontal; it supplies no transportation safety threshold, certification criterion, or proof for a particular system.
